reason: The Developer plan at $10/month is the analytically sound choice for small personal Python projects and lightweight web apps. It provides one web app, unlimited Python/bash consoles, full SSH access, unrestricted internet access, 5,000 CPU-seconds per day, IPython/Jupyter notebook support, and 5GB of disk space — all well-matched to the stated use case without unnecessary over-provisioning. The Beginner plan's severe restrictions (100 CPU-seconds/day, no SSH, restricted outbound internet, only 512MB storage) are structurally incompatible with reliable experimentation; that level of constraint introduces unacceptable risk to project continuity. The Custom plan is disproportionate for solo personal work. At $10/month, the cost is negligible relative to the high-income context, and the plan's fixed, clearly specified feature set satisfies the security-first, threat-focused cognitive style — there are no ambiguous variables.
